claims.statement: Account 7675/8093BA230 sent 8 transfers to 8 distinct counterparties between 2022-09-06 and 2022-09-08.
The only external incoming transfer before the fan-out was 83.45 EUR on 2022-09-02 from account 322542/8093B9E70.
Each of the 8 counterparties received exactly one transfer from this account with no prior transaction history.

findings.narrative: Account 7675/8093BA230 was opened on 2022-09-01, received a single external incoming transfer of 83.45 EUR on 2022-09-02 from account 322542/8093B9E70, and then within two days (2022-09-06 to 2022-09-08) sent 8 transfers to 8 different counterparties in 4 currencies (USD, EUR, INR, CAD). Each counterparty had no prior relationship with the account. The fan-out detector correctly flagged this burst of 8 transfers to 8 distinct accounts within a 96-hour window. The pattern — a new account with minimal funding rapidly dispersing funds to many new counterparties across multiple currencies — is consistent with a fan-out laundering scheme to fragment and move money.
